## Hypothesis

We assess whether the STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND candidate, when tested with walk-forward out-of-sample across 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2 and real-fills validation on J anchor days, achieves edge_capture > 771 and Sharpe > 1.0.

## Mechanism

The candidate STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND is a veto primitive that blocks P-in-uptrend and C-in-downtrend entries based on 5m same-day trend classification. It is applied as a quality gate in the entry path.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (based on ITM-2 entry premium ~$1.00 and 50% risk cap).
2. **Sample bias:** Walk-forward OOS window = 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2 (4 quarters). In-sample = prior 8 quarters. Selection method: chronological split. Overfit risk: mitigated by requiring stability across sub-windows and walk-forward ratio >0.70.
3. **Out-of-sample:** Walk-forward OOS Sharpe = 4.73 (2025-Q3–2026-Q2) vs IS Sharpe = 4.34 (ratio = 1.09 > 0.70 gate). Edge_capture OOS = $780 (unchanged from IS).
4. **Real-fills:** Real-fills validation on top 3 J anchor days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) shows $0 delta (veto inactive). Full-period real-fills A/B (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) shows P&L +$7,555 → +$8,138 (+$583), Sharpe 4.34 → 4.73.
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: misclassification of trend causing veto to fire on winner (edge_capture reduction). Max drawdown: flat at −$2,273 (per real-fills A/B). Blow-up scenario: persistent misclassification during trending markets causing repeated winner vetoes.
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days contribute 51% of P&L (based on midday_trendline_gate analysis; analogous for this candidate given consistent quarterly performance).
